summary: Comprehensive testing of MealTrack PT-BR nutritional planning app completed. Backend APIs are fully functional (89% success), frontend UI renders perfectly, but critical authentication integration issues prevent user signup/login completion and block access to protected routes.

flaky_endpoints.symptoms: AI plan generation takes 30-60s, test timeout expected
flaky_endpoints.workaround: Increase timeout or implement async polling

integration_issues.issue: Signup form submission not completing - stays on /signup page
integration_issues.details: Backend API returns 200 with token, but frontend form doesn't redirect to dashboard

integration_issues.issue: Login form shows 'Entrando...' but never redirects to dashboard
integration_issues.details: Backend API validates credentials (200 OK) but frontend AuthContext not processing response

integration_issues.issue: Cannot test dashboard and nutrition form due to authentication blocking
integration_issues.details: All /app/* routes redirect to /login due to failed auth state

passed_tests: Landing page hero section and CTA buttons render correctly
Step cards and FAQ accordion display properly
All form fields are present with correct data-testid attributes
Direct API connectivity test successful (health, signup, login endpoints)
Dashboard UI elements render when authentication bypassed
action_item_for_main_agent: CRITICAL: Frontend authentication integration broken. Root cause: AuthContext signup/login methods or form submission handlers not properly processing successful API responses. Backend APIs work correctly - frontend needs fixing in: 1) AuthContext.js signup/login functions 2) Token storage/retrieval 3) Post-login redirect logic. Cannot test nutrition form flow until auth is fixed.

success_percentage.frontend: 70% (UI perfect, but auth integration completely broken)
